author: WPB3
summary: Pre-alpha.1 static matrix of the renderer families' effect-aware draw routes, RenderTarget2D factories and real MRT and occlusion-query support, with the capability over-claims it exposed. Half the rows are retired families. The current rows and the over-claims (now mostly fixed) are on renderer-contract, render-targets and the modern-GPU evidence page. The residue added is a re-verified account of the former 'hybrid' routes: what SDL_GPU, WebGPU, OpenGL4, EasyGL and Vulkan do when a declaration lacks a semantic the stock effect reads, contrasted with XNA's VerifyCanDraw.

sections.heading: 4. Capability contradictions found by the matrix

concepts.text: The default DrawPrimitivesEx and DrawIndexedPrimitivesEx forward to the coloured draws and discard the whole GpuDrawParams description.

target.evidence: already stated on the destination page, which was checked at TARGET; re-read here: IGraphicsRenderer.hpp (DrawPrimitivesEx default)

concepts.text: CreateOcclusionQuery and CreateRenderTarget2D default to null, while SetRenderTargets is pure virtual so every family must decide how to accept or reject a target set.
tokens: SetRenderTargets were made pure on purpose

target.evidence: already stated on the destination page, which was checked at TARGET; re-read here: IGraphicsRenderer.hpp

concepts.text: Capability reporting is a separate path from factories and draws, so a true capability answer does not prove that a factory or draw route exists.

target.evidence: already stated on the destination page, which was checked at TARGET; re-read here: IGraphicsRenderer.hpp (SupportsCapability)

concepts.text: The matrix answers routing questions only (override or inherit, what the route does, RT2D, real MRT and occlusion), not per-field stock-effect fidelity.
concepts.note: Scope statement of the research document; the site's renderer-contract page states the same distinction in its evidence ladder.

concepts.text: The 2D-only families SDL_RENDERER, CANVAS, DIRECT2D, FREEDIRECT, HTML_DOM and SVG_DOM do not override the effect-aware draws; the inherited route reaches their coloured hooks or Ensure3DSupported and is refused.
tokens: Ensure3DSupported or their own coloured hooks

target.evidence: grep of DrawPrimitivesEx overrides in modules/renderers/*/src at 009d40f5 (none in those six families)

concepts.text: GDI overrides every 3D draw only to refuse it with NotSupportedException, independently of the WarnAndStub policy.

target.evidence: already stated on the destination page, which was checked at TARGET; re-read here: modules/renderers/gdi/src/GdiRenderer.cpp

concepts.text: STUB inherits the coloured fallback but its coloured draw is a no-op, and HEADLESS validates and records draws without rasterising.

target.evidence: already stated on the destination page, which was checked at TARGET; re-read here: StubRenderer.hpp; HeadlessRenderer.cpp

concepts.text: PORTABLEGL owns a CPU fixed pipeline for its draws but keeps the null render-target and occlusion-query factories.
tokens: PORTABLEGL and STUB keep the null render-target and occlusion-query defaults

target.evidence: grep of CreateRenderTarget2D/CreateOcclusionQuery overrides at 009d40f5 (none in portablegl, stub)

concepts.text: Real render-target and MRT support by family: EasyGL's ES 2.0 generation has one target, METAL refuses sets larger than one, the other 3D GPU families and SOFTWARE bind real multi-target sets.
tokens: Real; no MRT (one target), no MSAA, colour formats only

target.evidence: already stated on the destination page, which was checked at TARGET; re-read here: per-family SetRenderTargets implementations

concepts.text: Real occlusion-query support by family: EasyGL only outside the ES 2.0 generation, SDL_GPU and METAL refuse creation, WEBGPU and VULKAN return real counts.

target.evidence: already stated on the destination page, which was checked at TARGET; re-read here: per-family CreateOcclusionQuery

concepts.text: Rows and partition counts for the audited families that are no longer part of CNA.
concepts.note: Retired renderer families (draw-path matrix section 2 rows and the mechanical partition counts).

concepts.text: One family inherited both defaults while having a real coloured submission path, so every effect-aware draw became a plausible untextured coloured result.
concepts.note: Subject is a retired renderer family (draw-path matrix 3.1).

concepts.text: An inherited coloured fallback turns an effect request into a plausible untextured result rather than an error; at this snapshot no 3D-capable family inherits it.
tokens: an effect request can come back as an untextured coloured result

target.evidence: already stated on the destination page, which was checked at TARGET; re-read here: DrawPrimitivesEx overrides of every 3D family

concepts.text: SDL_GPU dispatched supported stride/effect combinations and otherwise called its coloured route, so an unsupported effect on a 16-byte layout could draw a coloured approximation.
concepts.note: At TARGET the shape comes from the effect family and declared semantics; missing defining inputs throw NotSupportedException (skinning std::invalid_argument); BasicEffect texturing or lighting the declaration cannot feed is dropped.

concepts.text: WEBGPU had the same unmatched-combination coloured tail, drawing only for 16-byte layouts.
concepts.note: Narrowed but still present at TARGET: alpha test or dual texture without TEXCOORD0 reaches the coloured route (stride-16 only), and environment mapping or non-skinned PBR without their inputs fall through to a BasicEffect shape (WPB3-i002).

concepts.text: OPENGL4 called its coloured route when no program matched the stride, guarded so that unsupported non-coloured layouts failed loudly.
concepts.note: At TARGET the program is chosen from effect state; the declaration guard refuses only unconvertible formats and a missing semantic reads (0, 0, 0, 1).

concepts.text: A fixed-function ES family sent skinning, PBR, custom effects and instancing to its coloured route by design.
concepts.note: Subject is a retired renderer family (draw-path matrix 3.2 first bullet).

concepts.text: The three-level answer: families inheriting the default, overriding families with a conditional coloured tail, and overriding families with direct dispatch only.
tokens: only WebGPU keeps a coloured tail
concepts.note: At TARGET the inheriting families are the 2D-only ones and STUB, and of the three former hybrids only WebGPU keeps a coloured tail.

concepts.text: XNA and CNA differ when a vertex declaration lacks a semantic the stock effect reads: XNA's GraphicsDevice.VerifyCanDraw throws InvalidOperationException, while CNA has no shared check and its families read a (0, 0, 0, 1) neutral record, alias another UV set, substitute another stock shape or refuse.
concepts.note: New residue derived from the matrix's 'silent parameter loss' question; recorded as WPB3-i001/i002.

concepts.section: 4. Capability contradictions found by the matrix
concepts.text: HEADLESS, SOFTWARE and WEBGPU answered MultipleRenderTargets true while refusing any set larger than one.
tokens: Software binds up to four CPU targets
concepts.note: Fixed for SOFTWARE and WEBGPU; the device also ANDs the answer with the profile limit.

concepts.section: 4. Capability contradictions found by the matrix
concepts.text: SDL_GPU, WEBGPU, SOFTWARE and HEADLESS answered OcclusionQuery true without a real query path.
tokens: its query always reports one visible sample
concepts.note: SDL_GPU now answers false, WEBGPU and SOFTWARE return real counts; HEADLESS is Known Issues item CNA-BUG-054.

concepts.section: 4. Capability contradictions found by the matrix
concepts.text: The shared capability test compared one reported Boolean with a hard-coded expectation and never tried a two-target bind or a usable query object.
concepts.note: At TARGET a behavioural two-target MRT test exists and expectations are keyed on the active renderer; the occlusion-query and custom-effect expectations still use a permissive default arm (Known Issues item CNA-BUG-012).

concepts.text: A successful effect-aware draw call is not evidence that the requested effect was honoured; capability tables must be derived from implementation behaviour.
tokens: A test of a custom vertex layout must still check pixels or bindings
